name: Sugal & Damani Share Brokers Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, Sugal & Damani Share Brokers Ltd are a share broker[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
a) Dealing in shares and other Securities in Secondary Markets
b) Identifying investment avenues and advising on portfolio management
c) Underwriting and broking for New Issues
d) Financial and advisory services, brokerage & distribution of equities, commodities, etc.

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 19.9% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 12.8% over last 3 years.
